company_overview.principal_activities: Manufacture and sale of processed meats, raw meats, crumbed products and other convenience food products
company_overview.subsidiaries_associates: John Keells Foods India (Private) Limited (subsidiary; no commercial operations during the year)

shareholder_information.major_shareholders: John Keells Holdings PLC and subsidiaries – 89.95%
shareholder_information.dividends: Total dividend Rs. 2.45 per share (interim dividends paid; final dividend Rs. 1.15 declared post year-end)

risk_factors.liquidity_risk: Net negative cash position and reliance on overdraft facilities
risk_factors.credit_risk: Exposure mainly from trade receivables; ECL provision Rs. 11.6 million
risk_factors.market_risk: Exposure to interest rate and foreign exchange movements
risk_factors.interest_rate_risk: Sensitivity to floating rate borrowings disclosed
risk_factors.foreign_exchange_risk: Exposure from imports and limited overseas operations
risk_factors.operational_risk: Supply chain disruption risk including African Swine Fever (ASF)
risk_factors.regulatory_risk: Food safety, data protection and tax regulation compliance
risk_factors.going_concern_concerns: Directors concluded adequate resources to continue as a going concern
risk_factors.litigation_contingencies: No material litigation expected to impact results

management_governance.board_changes: Directors subject to retirement and re-election at AGM; committee restructuring effective October 2024
management_governance.auditor_opinion: Unqualified audit opinion by Ernst & Young
management_governance.related_party_transactions: No non-recurrent related party transactions during the year
management_governance.corporate_governance_statements: Compliant with CSE Listing Rules and corporate governance best practices
management_governance.director_responsibility_statement: Statement included affirming responsibility for financial statements

future_outlook.chairman_ceo_outlook: Positive outlook driven by macroeconomic recovery and consumer demand rebound
future_outlook.expansion_plans: Focus on export growth, dry range expansion, and new product launches
future_outlook.expected_challenges: Input price volatility, supply chain risks, and currency fluctuations
future_outlook.strategy: Strategic pricing, innovation, channel expansion, and operational efficiency
future_outlook.forward_looking_statements: Growth expectations subject to macroeconomic and geopolitical risks

investor_friendly_insight.summary: Keells Food Products PLC delivered a strong turnaround in FY2024/25, returning to profitability with improved margins and positive operating cash flows despite higher working capital needs.
key_strengths: Return to profitability with improved operating margins
Strong market position in processed meats
Support from John Keells Group as majority shareholder
key_concerns: Net negative cash position and reliance on overdrafts
Exposure to raw material price volatility and ASF-related supply risks
investor_friendly_insight.risk_level_explanation: The Group faces moderate risk, balancing improved profitability against liquidity pressure and operational risks inherent in the food processing industry.
investor_friendly_insight.non_advisory_note: This is an informational summary only and not financial advice.
